note: Measurements of the library, carried into compliance_report() as dated evidence rows. Each names the probe that recomputes it and the sha256 of its receipt; a receipt that no longer hashes to this reads STALE in the report. They describe the library, not any particular store, and they are not a certification.

rows.property: resilience to a corrected fact being re-asserted
rows.summary: a restated stale value is retired on arrival (echo_blocked 1.00); the safe, context and trusting policies are the panel's other rows

rows.metric: influence_hijack across 3 dense retrievers (raw_hijack without the gate)
rows.summary: AgentPoison-style planted memories hijack 0.875 to 1.000 of queries at the retriever and 0.000 once the influence gate decides what may DRIVE a response

rows.property: detection of operator-side tampering (a split view)
rows.metric: fork detected on a forked co-signed pair; not on the honest pair
rows.summary: two histories served to two readers are proven from one witness's two signatures (fork True), and an append-only pair is not flagged (control fork False)
